name: GateStructure - Default (seed v2)
description: A gate: its name, address, WorldGuard region, spawn point, warp destination and siege behaviour. Its doors are their own records, added on the last step once the gate is saved. Seed v2 (KNG-229): /navigate default, entry rule on roads and the warp destination step, as on the Structure form.

steps.description: Name the gate. The name is shown in game and is how /gate commands find it.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in game and used by /gate commands, so keep it short. 'here' is reserved and refused.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: One line for admins and the web app, e.g. what the gate guards.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Item shown for this gate in menus. Leave empty for the default icon.

steps.description: Where the gate stands. Pick the district first; create the street here if it doesn't exist yet.

fields.label: District
fields.description: The district the gate belongs to. Its region is checked against the district's region on the next step.

fields.label: Street
fields.description: The street the gate is on. Use Create New if the street isn't there yet.

steps.description: The WorldGuard region around the whole gate, and whether players may walk in and out of it. Use Send to Minecraft and select the region in game with WorldEdit, or type an existing region's name.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The WorldGuard region that encloses the gate and all its doors. Door points are checked against it, and it should lie inside the district's region.

fields.label: Allow entry
fields.description: Players may walk into the gate's region. Off keeps everyone out except admins.

fields.label: Allow exit
fields.description: Players inside the gate's region may walk out of it.

fields.label: Entry rule on roads
fields.description: Applies: when players may not enter, /navigate routes avoid the roads through this gate's region. Ignored: routes may use them, e.g. for a gate that spans a public road; the rule still holds at the border and for teleports. Empty = the setting for all gates on the Roads page.

steps.description: Where /gate tp, /warp and /navigate <gate> put players. Stand on the spot in game, facing the gate, and use Send to Minecraft.

fields.label: Spawn point
fields.description: Optional, but a warp destination needs one. Without it, /gate tp puts players next to the gate's first door.

fields.label: Navigate to
fields.description: Where /navigate <gate> leads when the player names no spot: Spawn = the spawn point above, Region = the nearest edge of the gate's region. Leave empty to follow the setting for all gates on the Roads page.

steps.description: Whether players can /warp to the gate's spawn point, and what that requires. Requirements are checked in this order: title, premium tier, discovery, price.

fields.label: Warp destination
fields.description: Lists the gate in /warp and the teleport menu. It also needs a spawn point and Allow entry on. Off keeps the settings below but doesn't use them.

fields.label: Price (gems)
fields.description: Gems charged per warp, after the warmup. 0 = free. A permission group's /warp price setting can replace or multiply it.

fields.label: Minimum title
fields.description: Players whose experience is below this title can't warp here. Empty = no title needed.

fields.label: Minimum premium tier
fields.description: Only players whose highest premium tier has at least this group's weight may warp here. Only premium-tier groups can be picked. Empty = everyone.

fields.label: Discovered gates only
fields.description: Only players who have discovered the gate (entered its region at least once) may warp here. Gate discovery is on by default; if it is switched off for gates on the discovery page, nobody new can discover the gate.

steps.description: How the gate behaves while a siege match has it locked down.

fields.label: Animate during a siege
fields.description: Doors open and close with their animation during a match. Off switches them instantly.

fields.label: Siege may take over
fields.description: A siege match may take control of this gate's doors (open, close, destroy). Off keeps the gate out of every siege.

steps.description: The doors that open and close. Save the gate first (Submit), then Edit it to add doors; each door has its own form and is saved when you finish it.

fields.label: Doors
fields.description: One entry per door. Create New opens the door form with this gate already filled in.

validationRules.errorMessage: The gate's region is not completely inside the district's region.
